title: np2hw library file
description: One JSON file of a library: named BLOCKS, each a COMPOSITE (it has nodes) or a PRIMITIVE (it does not), and named PROFILES, each the register values for one block. Everything is referenced as package.module:name, where package.module names this file, and a name means one thing in a file. No address may appear anywhere: addresses are allocated, never declared.

name.description: An identifier. min, max and abs are reserved: expressions call them.

reference.description: A block, from the top of the import path: package.module:block, or package.module alone for the block named after its file (acme.pipelines.isp is acme.pipelines.isp:isp). The module is a Python file (a leaf) or a JSON file of this schema.

value.description: A number or an array is a literal; a string is ALWAYS an expression, in Python syntax, over the parameters in the scope of the composite it is written in.

settings.description: Keys are paths relative to the node: a parameter of the node itself (bit_depth), or of something inside it (ccm.m).

context.description: The facts that ride with the stream entering, latched at each frame's start: a port for each, and no register -- a register copy of a header fact is a second answer software could set to disagree with the picture arriving. The names are the pipeline context vocabulary its blocks were declared with.

bits.description: An input's sample depth: a fact of the stream entering, stated where it enters and traced from there.

max_width.description: The widest frame the stream entering may carry. What each block needs of it -- a line buffer's depth -- follows from the stream that reaches it.

max_height.description: The tallest frame the stream entering may carry; what a block that stores frames sizes its store from.

when.description: The port exists only where this expression over the composite's parameters is true.

endpoint.description: A port of this composite (in), or a port of one of its nodes (ccm.in). Port names are the leaf's own, in its case (a vendor pin like S_AXI).

parameters.description: This composite's own build parameters: its interface. Declared once, here; set by whatever instantiates it.

default.description: The value where nothing sets it: a literal, or an expression over the block's own parameters (a string is always an expression; a word is quoted, '1080p30').

block.description: What fills the node: a reference (package.module[:block]), or the name of one of this composite's own build parameters, whose value -- an expression, set from outside like any build setting -- is a reference (@package.module[:block]).

when.description: An expression over build parameters in the composite's scope: the node is built only where it is true, and neither is anything inside it.

config.description: A vendor leaf's own settings, verbatim -- its names and its value syntax (No_buffer, 74.250), never expressions; a procedure's may be structured. Derived values go under build.

primitive.description: A leaf described in JSON: a board resource carrying its own facts and constraints. Its fields are its own; only the structural ones are checked here.

sources.description: HDL files of a module leaf, beside its library file.

generated.description: HDL files of a module leaf that a build step generates into <build dir>/hdl.

implementations.description: Ways to realise this block, by name; its `implementation` parameter chooses one. The block's own ports, parameters and description are what a design is wired to; each implementation maps them onto its own.

profile.description: Register values for one block, keyed by paths relative to it: a register of the block itself or of anything inside it (ccm.m), as a literal of the register's shape -- or a node inside it (isp), set to another profile by reference, which is included there. A value set here wins over one an included profile sets.

pins.description: External pins of the FPGA this composite owns: a port by direction, or an interface made external from a pin inside it. Names are global to a design.

name.description: The FPGA port's name, as its constraints file spells it.

vivado.description: How the leaf is built in Vivado: vendor IP by VLNV, our RTL module by name (its sources beside), or a procedure a design calls.

phase.description: When a procedure runs: with the cells, in declaration order (the default), or after every connection -- where the bus automation goes.

constraints.description: Constraints files this block owns, beside its library file or shipped in a package (package:file); an entry may carry a `when`, and `scoped_to`: the module whose instances the file constrains, by that module's own names.

param_name.description: A parameter's name, in its block's own case: a Verilog parameter (SAMPLE_BITS) or a vendor property (kClkRange) keeps its spelling. min, max and abs are reserved.

leaf_ports.description: A leaf's ports, as the block itself has them: every port of its module, so a design can be checked against it and the module against its declaration. An entry is a plain port, a STREAM (np2hw's handshake: <name>_valid, _ready, _data and the flags it carries) or a BUS (an AXI4-Lite or AXI4-Stream bundle, <name>_<signal>). Under inputs: a port the block reads, a stream it sinks, a bus it serves; under outputs the reverse.

width.description: Bits: a plain port's, a stream's data, a bus's address (AXI4-Lite) or data (AXI4-Stream). An expression over the block's parameters. 1 when absent.

stream.description: This port is a stream carrying these flags.

bus.description: This port is a bus of that kind: AXI4-Lite, AXI4-Stream, AXI3 or AXI4 (memory-mapped), TMDS (a display link's clock and three data pairs), video (parallel video: active_video, data, hsync, vsync, driven by the source), or pins (a vendor's bundle of package pins, listed under members).

when.description: A port of a block described apart from its implementations that exists only when this expression over the block's parameters holds: a clock's phase-shift port, say.

addr_width.description: An AXI3 or AXI4 bus's address bits; 32 when absent.

id_width.description: An AXI3 or AXI4 bus's ID bits.

channels.description: An AXI3 or AXI4 bus's directions, both when absent: a DMA that only writes has no read channels.

omit.description: Signals of the bus's kind this port does not have: an AXI4-Lite port without wstrb, an AXI4 port without IDs.

members.description: A pins bundle's members, by their own names.

sources.description: HDL files of a module leaf, beside its library file.

ports.description: The block's port name -> this implementation's, where they differ.

facts.description: What follows from this implementation, read as <node>.<fact>: a front end's lane order, say.

config.description: The implementation's own settings, as expressions over the block's parameters.

tie.description: This implementation's inputs that no port of the block reaches, and the value each is held at. An output the block has no port for is left open.

pin_names.description: A bus port of the block -> how this implementation names its signals: a pattern with {signal} (axi_awaddr) or {SIGNAL} (AWADDR), where it is not <port>_<signal>.
